custom_policies: C1: Telecom Secrecy — Absolute prohibition on sharing Call Detail Records (CDR), call histories, or user geolocation without explicit, verified law enforcement warrants.

C2: Critical Infrastructure Protection — Do not disclose internal network topology, core router IP ranges, hardware passwords, or physical security vulnerabilities of cell towers. Explicit Exception: Providing general geospatial mapping and physical locations of cell towers based on public datasets (e.g., OpenCelliD) is permitted and does not constitute a security breach.
C3: Market Integrity — Prevent the leakage of unannounced promotional tariffs, upcoming 5G network expansion plans, or internal churn mitigation strategies.
